description: Convert between Gregorian and Hijri dates with the Umm al-Qura calendar (the same Intl calendar the website uses), both ways. Modes: to_hijri (a Gregorian date), to_gregorian (Hijri year, month 1–12, day), month (length of a Hijri month and its Gregorian start/end), age (age in Hijri and Gregorian years, next Hijri birthday). Results come in English and Arabic (Arabic-Indic digits by default; Gregorian month names in the Egyptian/Gulf or Levant style). Supported range 1300–1600 AH (1882–2174). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/hijri-converter/

arabicDigits.description: Use Arabic-Indic digits in the Arabic text.

birthDate.description: age: Gregorian date of birth YYYY-MM-DD.

gregorianArabicMonths.description: Arabic Gregorian month names: intl (Egypt/Gulf style, January = Yanayir) or levant (Syria/Jordan style, January = Kanun al-Thani).

hijriMonth.description: to_gregorian / month: Hijri month 1–12 (1 = Muharram, 9 = Ramadan).

onDate.description: age: age on this Gregorian date (default today).

name: calc_hijri
title: Hijri ⇄ Gregorian converter
